name: ai-voice
title: AI Voice
description: A voice capture control: a round microphone button starts recording, a scrolling level waveform and timer track the take, then play, discard and send appear for review.
use: Users should speak a prompt instead of typing, with a visible level and a chance to review it.
avoid: You need real audio: the component shows a level and a playhead but plays nothing itself.
a11y: The main button is labelled and announces its state, and reduced motion freezes the waveform; the bars themselves are hidden from assistive tech. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: respected)
looks: Centred on black, a circular button holds a microphone, red stop square or play and pause icon inside a soft red halo. Below it a monospace timer with a small red dot sits over a row of thin vertical level bars, and a short caption or Discard and Send buttons close the stack.
behaves: Starting a recording swaps the mic for a red stop square, makes the halo swell with the voice and slides new waveform bars in from the right while the timer counts. Stopping freezes the take into a full waveform, shows playback controls and review actions, and playing sweeps a darker copy across the bars.
customise: The demo flag, live level and callbacks are props; captions, bar count, colours and sample timing are written in the file.
weight: moderate: A requestAnimationFrame loop drives about fifty bars while recording; it stops once in review.
